sanskrit:
ततः स विस्मयाविष्टो हृष्टरोमा धनञ्जयः।
प्रणम्य शिरसा देवं कृताञ्जलिरभाषत।।
caption:
Chapter 11, Verse 14

Arjuna’s reaction. ‘tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo’ (Then, bewildered and astonished). ‘hṛṣṭa-romā dhanañjayaḥ’ (His hair standing on end). ‘praṇamya śirasā devaṁ’ (He bowed his head to offer obeisances). ‘kṛtāñjalir abhāṣata’ (And with folded hands, began to pray). The reaction is ‘Vismaya’ (wonder/shock) and ‘Hrishta-roma’ (goosebumps/ecstasy). It is too big to comprehend. Arjuna instinctively bows down and folds his hands. He is no longer the casual friend; he is the worshiper.
